// diagnostic

E0734

Tag `{tag}` has an incomplete policy.

What

Tag `{tag}` has an incomplete policy.

Why

A value tag's denials are its own `#FX(!…)` row; its `impl Marker` block holds `sites: [.TypeUse]` and, optionally, `from`, `timing` and `protects`.

Fix

Write `#FX(!Net) {tag}: struct { impl Marker { sites: [.TypeUse] } }` with the destinations it may not reach; add `from: [source.path]` when it is needed.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0734: Tests/UI/tag_marker_ceiling_entry.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidTagPolicy]: `Net` in the tag `Risk`'s `#FX` row is a ceiling, not a denial
  --> Tests/UI/tag_marker_ceiling_entry.jet:3:12
    |
  3 | #FX(!Exec, Net)
    |            ^^^
 Why: A value tag's `#FX` row lists the destinations its values may not reach; a tag grants no effects
 Fix: Write `!Net` to deny it, or remove it
